address: 13/9 Mu 4, Ko Pha-ngan, Surat Thani, 84280, Thailand

address: 98/17 Mu 2, Soi Khun Kaeo 12, Khun Kaeo, Nakhon Chai Si, Nakhon Pathom, 73120, Thailand
description: Four times in a decade, this Thai restaurant changed locations before finally opening on the chef-owner’s land in Nakhon Pathom. The current digs are in an open-air pavilion on a country lane with tranquil lotus pond views. Try the stir-fried pork loin with jaew sauce and the spicy mackerel soup with madan fruit.
